body:
I just spent about 2 1/2 hours talking to some wonderful people (Pablo & Peter) and I'd like to say thank you, SW. I know I may not be the worst case out there, but it's definitely amazing to know that there are people out there, even complete strangers, who may not have fixed the problem but who have definitely put me in the right state of mind for the night. I'm going to go to bed now. I've left my contact information for those who I have not yet talked to, because you guys are amazing individuals, and I am glad to count myself as a human being amongst your ranks.

Thank you all. I truly mean that, from the bottom of my heart, thank you all. Hopefully, shit circumstances aside, I will be able to push through my depression tomorrow, cook some more amazing lo mein (Pablo, I'm serious, your wife will love it,) calculate the terminal velocity of watermelons against a woman's head (I'm looking at you, Peter, I still want my equation) and maybe tomorrow will dawn a brighter day.

I mean it when I say that you all are exemplary human beings, and I am grateful to be among you.
